description: This file contains template metaprogramming utilities for type traits related to 'ModuleHolder' types in PyTorch, including SFINAE techniques, type trait definitions, and helper templates for template specialization and method return type deduction.

classes.name: ModuleHolderIndicator
classes.description: A marker struct used for SFINAE to identify types that are 'ModuleHolder's.

methods.name: is_module_holder_of
methods.description: Template to check if a type T is a 'ModuleHolder' of a specific contained type C.

methods.name: return_type_of_forward
methods.description: Template to deduce the return type of the 'forward()' method if it exists.
